text:
alex: Kicking off onboarding for convoy-9b. Need a perf plan focused on throughput vs batch size and context-length impact. Also running int8 quant experiments and quick quality checks against prod_prompts_v2. Who can own baseline runs and quant?

kira: @alex sounds good. For baseline propose batch sizes: 1,2,4,8,16 and token lengths: 128,512,2048,8192. Capture p50/p95/p99, GPU util, and per-token cost.

mike: I can take the baseline sweep. Also recommend a continuous-batching scenario (burst 50 req/s for 30s) to catch tail behavior. I'll schedule that after batch grid.

benchbot: queued job convoy9b-baseline-1978012345: fp16 batch-sweep (1,2,4,8,16) started. dashboard: https://internal.redwood/bench/convoy9b/1978012345

alex: For quant: run int8-dynamic and int8-static (calibrate with 500 samples from prod_prompts_v2). Track LMScore / perplexity deltas and eval set pass rates. If quality delta >2% on our core evals, fallback to fp16. Also collect token-EM/ROUGE where applicable.

kira: Draft quick checklist to keep things tight:
- [ ] baseline fp16 batch sweep
- [ ] context-length sweep 128/512/2048/8192
- [ ] continuous-batch burst test
- [ ] int8-dynamic run
- [ ] int8-static + calibration (500 samples)
- [ ] run evals: prod_prompts_v2, chat-safety-smoke, retrieval-rerank
- [ ] perf profile & model card update
- [ ] register perf profile in catalog

mike: I'll own baseline + ctx sweep. kicking off batch=1 now. quick log: ```JOB convoy9b-baseline-1978012345 batch=1 p95=83ms p99=120ms gpu_util=42%```

doria: FYI infra maintenance planned 1978-03-24 might touch GPU firmware; try to complete heavy runs before then.

kira: After mike posts all baseline numbers I'll start int8 calibration. Will post calibration artifacts and the quantized weights.

alex: Canary/rollout policy: 5% traffic, 30min window, p95 <= 2.0x baseline and quality regression <=1.5% absolute on core evals. If either fails, automatic rollback to fp16. I'll add the canary config to the rollout repo. :thumbsup:

mike: baseline complete for batches [1,2,4]; attaching summary to dashboard. Next run: burst pattern then remaining batches.

kira: started int8-static calibration (500 samples). logs: ```calib: 500 samples processed, mean bias=0.03, max bias=0.12```

alex: Great. Once we have numbers export everything to /bench/results/convoy-9b/1978012345/ and tag with perf/latency/quant. I'll convert into a heatmap view for the team. Ping @kira @mike if anything flaky shows up.
